code.pseudocode: Precision and recall from every fold.
code.python:
folds = [(3, 2, 1, 14), (4, 1, 0, 15), (3, 2, 1, 14), (3, 1, 1, 15), (3, 2, 1, 14)]   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) per fold
for i, (tp, fp, fn, tn) in enumerate(folds, 1):
    print('fold', i, 'precision', round(tp / (tp + fp), 2), 'recall', round(tp / (tp + fn), 2))
# prints: fold 1 precision 0.6 recall 0.75
# prints: fold 2 precision 0.8 recall 1.0
# prints: fold 3 precision 0.6 recall 0.75
# prints: fold 4 precision 0.75 recall 0.75
# prints: fold 5 precision 0.6 recall 0.75

folds = [(3, 2, 1, 14), (4, 1, 0, 15), (3, 2, 1, 14), (3, 1, 1, 15), (3, 2, 1, 14)]   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) per fold
ps = [tp / (tp + fp) for tp, fp, fn, tn in folds]
rs = [tp / (tp + fn) for tp, fp, fn, tn in folds]
print('average precision', round(sum(ps) / 5, 2), 'recall', round(sum(rs) / 5, 2))
# prints: average precision 0.67 recall 0.8
